system.description: The crew has access to a safe house in the resonance field. It can be accessed once per score, from anywhere. The door always returns to the same place it was entered from. Use it as a hiding place, to reequip, repair, or just take a breather. Any PCs who enter gain +1 load. One PC may clear all level 1 harm via emergency medical supplies there. Note that time still passes in the outside world.
